reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch confirm the total of thirty-seven mighty men in 2 Samuel 23:39 by tallying three named classes of three, two, and thirty-two fighters.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible counts only thirty-six names in the roster of 2 Samuel 23:8-39 against the text's own claimed total of thirty-seven.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.
sides.verseText: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.

sides.snippet: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam
sides.verseText: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
